review_panel.finding: Audited contracts/wit/search-provider.wit, contracts/examples/provider-component.yaml, and contracts/json-schema/provider-component.v1.schema.json. Verified search-provider package world, types interface (compiled-strategy, execution-policy, search-request, provider-page, provider-error), export declarations, capability definitions, and memory/fuel limits.

Audited crates/searchright-policy/src/lib.rs and crates/searchright-plugin-sdk/src/lib.rs. Verified ExecutionEnvelope network capability, allowlisted HTTPS endpoints, human approver requirement for network operations, PolicyDecision enum, validate_request helper, and content safety inspection dispositions across DataOnly, SanitiseThenDataOnly, and HumanInspectionRequired.

Audited crates/searchright-mcp/src/lib.rs, crates/searchright-mcp/tests/advanced_mcp.rs, and contracts/openapi/searchright-http.openapi.yaml. Confirmed bounded local-stdio task admission (4 slots), cooperative task cancellation, subscription aggregate task notifications, and Candidate HTTP OpenAPI routes (/v1/reviews/{review_id}/compile and /v1/reviews/{review_id}/audit/verify) while keeping Streamable HTTP and OAuth 2.0 proxy tokens unpromoted.

Upgraded all six Track 24 assertions (T24-A001..T24-A006) to symbol_and_gate_mapped with concrete implementation symbols across crates/searchright-plugin-sdk, crates/searchright-policy, crates/searchright-contracts, crates/searchright-store, crates/searchright-mcp, contracts/openapi/searchright-http.openapi.yaml, and tests/test_wasi_http_scale_governance.py in both conductor/tracks/24-wasi-http-scale/traceability.json and conductor/traceability-overrides.json (0/6 empty symbols).

Preserved WASI and scalable execution gating state without premature completion: implementation_state remains partially_implemented; WASI component compilation/conformance suite, compiled WIT host/guest boundary with Wasmtime controls, Arrow/Parquet/DuckDB large corpus engines, authenticated Streamable HTTP/OAuth transport, overload/disconnect/chaos tests, and accountable publisher identity/revocation propagation remain explicitly open.
